notes.title: World of Sea Battle releases October 21st!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Port Steam is on the horizon, Captains![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We have travelled far and wide in search of the famous port of Steam - and now, our spyglasses are locked on sight!

Next month, [b]the release of World of Sea Battle on Steam comes[/b]! We're also unveiling a brand-new server to cater to our EU captains - more on this soon.[/p][p][/p][h3]For now, check out the release date teaser video below![/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="C2NScGcPvCU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Remember, Captains - we land at the port of Steam on the [b]21st of October, 2025[/b]! Ready your crew for a new journey at the high seas![/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Become a Part of our Journey![/h2][p][/p][p]Venturing into once-unknown waters has made our crew a little weary from its pursuit of knowledge and treasure. While sugar and rum would be adequate gifts to receive, we'd love nothing more than support from our fellow Captains beyond our spyglasses![/p][h3][url="https://discord.com/invite/3XJyVctcTd" style="button"]Official World of Sea Battle Int'l Discord Server[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/WoSB/" style="button"]Official World of Sea Battle Subreddit[/url][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Follow us on our new and official links below![/b][/h3][h3][url="https://x.com/WOSB_Game" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on X[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61576585498837" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on Facebook[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.instagram.com/worldofseabattle_game" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on Instagram[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@worldofseabattle_game" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on TikTok[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.youtube.com/@WorldofSeaBattleENG" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on YouTube[/url][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948190/World_of_Sea_Battle/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Shanties of the High Seas - Anniversary Sea Shanty-making Event!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125593/c998cb080c33482ac51eb94fbc8d79265a562825.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Ahoy Captains![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]While we've had another successful year of voyages in the high seas of The Archipelago - some of our crew have grown weary from the journey, and are looking for new tunes to sing along while working on the deck![/p][p]Us Captains need to take care of our crew's well-being. And with that said - we're looking for the best new shanties out there! [/p][p]Create your own sea shanty, share it with us, and get awesome prizes! You'll never know - [i]maybe it'll make it into the game somehow[/i]...[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Event Duration[/b][/h3][p][b]STARTS [/b]Friday, June 27, 2025 12:00 PM EDT[/p][p][b]SUBMISSIONS and VOTING Period ENDS [/b]Friday, July 4, 2025 2:00 PM EDT[/p][p][b]Winner ANNOUNCEMENT [/b]Monday, July 7, 2025 2:00 PM EDT[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Top 3 most upvoted submissions get exclusive rewards![/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]How to Join & More Event Details:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Write your own Sea Shanty lyrics and share them in the <shanty-event> channel on Discord in a single forum post![/p][/*][*][p]Want to increase your chances and get more valuable rewards? Submit an audio clip of your Sea Shanty together with the lyrics![/p][/*][*][p]Devs will be looking at all submissions to pick out their best pick. The Dev Pick will win 2nd prize rewards![/p][/*][*][p]Upvote emojis on your post count towards your popularity vote![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Event Rewards[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]1st Prize:[/b] 1 Steam-release Exclusive Reward + 1000 Coins[/p][/*][*][p][b]2nd Prize:[/b] 1 Steam-release Exclusive Reward + 800 Coins[/p][/*][*][p][b]3rd Prize:[/b] 500 Coins[/p][/*][*][p][b]All participants[/b] deemed by the team to have submitted a material of outstanding quality (even if just lyrics, no audio clips) will be given [b]+100 Coins[/b] as part of your prize, no matter your standing in the competition.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All validated submitters[/b] get 250 Coins when the Steam version comes out.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]NOTE: All rewards will be activated when the Steam version of World of Sea Battle releases.[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Questions and Answers[/b][/h3][list][*][p]What is a Sea Shanty?[/p][list][*][p]Sea shanties are old sailors’ work songs, sung to keep rhythm during tough tasks like hauling ropes or hoisting sails. Led by a shantyman, crews would join in with strong, simple choruses to turn hard labor into something almost musical. With tales of the sea, lost loves, and far-off ports, these songs kept spirits high and hands moving - salt-soaked teamwork, set to a beat.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]How would I know if my submission is correct?[/p][list][*][p]The minimum submission type for the event are the lyrics to your shanty. It doesn't need to be very long - just enough to make a lively, sea shanty tune out of it.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Got more questions?[/p][list][*][p]If you have more questions, just chat with us on the <shanty-talk> channel on Discord. We'll help you out as much as we can.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]If upvote manipulation is discovered, your submission won't be counted.[/b][/h3][p][/p][h2]Good luck, Captains![/h2][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Become a Part of our Journey![/h2][p][/p][p]Venturing into once-unknown waters has made our crew a little weary from its pursuit of knowledge and treasure. While sugar and rum would be adequate gifts to receive, we'd love nothing more than support from our fellow Captains beyond our spyglasses![/p][h3][url="https://discord.com/invite/3XJyVctcTd" style="button"]Official World of Sea Battle Int'l Discord Server[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/WoSB/" style="button"]Official World of Sea Battle Subreddit[/url][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Follow us on our new and official links below![/b][/h3][h3][url="https://x.com/WOSB_Game" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on X[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61576585498837" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on Facebook[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.instagram.com/worldofseabattle_game" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on Instagram[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@worldofseabattle_game" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on TikTok[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.youtube.com/@WorldofSeaBattleENG" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on YouTube[/url][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948190/World_of_Sea_Battle/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: A New Heading - Steam & Discord!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125593/34f1974f567dad03c8aff7ea5951f63f086f7391.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Ahoy Captains![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Welcome to World of Sea Battle on Steam! We're excited to talk about where the game's headed as we bridge the gap between Steam and the Archipelago ahead of its release![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been hard at work polishing the deck and tightening the sails - [b]World of Sea Battle[/b] is looking sharper than ever. Here’s what’s new across the fleet:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Steam Page Overhaul - Where it hits home![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125593/304d084f39d94d1a9fdcf96aaef91992180cf8a2.png"][/img][/p][p]Our [b]Steam page has received a full makeover[/b]! We’ve updated the game descriptions to better reflect the core experience and added [b]GIFs that showcase the game in action[/b] - from intense naval duels to strategic plays on the open sea.[/p][p][/p][p]Even better, the page is now [b]localized in 7 additional languages - French, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, and German[/b], opening up the seas to a global fleet of new players. No matter your port of origin, your journey starts here.[/p][p][/p][p]No time like the present! Wishlist World of Sea Battle on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948190/World_of_Sea_Battle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][h2]A New Look on Discord[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125593/368fc9e0c7c3b23dbac94d6ec83ea249d2820f38.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve revamped the [b]World of Sea Battle Discord server[/b] from bow to stern. It’s now more structured, intuitive, and welcoming for both seasoned sailors and fresh recruits.[/p][p]Whether you're looking to swap strategies, suggest features, or just chat with fellow players - we’ve made it easier than ever.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Stay tuned:[/b] We're cooking up a set of community events on Discord and beyond. Every captain in the Archipelago knows they're not about to miss any of them out![/p][p]Here's a small clue for those treasure-seekers who reached the depths of this post: [b]Shanties[/b]![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Become a Part of our Journey![/h2][p][/p][p]Venturing into once-unknown waters has made our crew a little weary from its pursuit of knowledge and treasure. While sugar and rum would be adequate gifts to receive, we'd love nothing more than support from our fellow Captains beyond our spyglasses![/p][h3][url="https://discord.com/invite/3XJyVctcTd" style="button"]Official World of Sea Battle Int'l Discord Server[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/wosb" style="button"]Official World of Sea Battle Subreddit[/url][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Follow us on our new and official links below![/b][/h3][h3][url="https://x.com/WOSB_Official1" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on X[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61576585498837" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on Facebook[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.instagram.com/wosb_official1/" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on Instagram[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@wosb_official1" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on TikTok[/url][/h3][h3][url="https://www.youtube.com/@WorldofSeaBattleENG" style="button"]World of Sea Battle on YouTube[/url][/h3]
